title: NavLinkRenderProps
summary: Values passed to NavLink styling and children callbacks.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Contains isActive and isPending booleans. isActive uses pathname matching; end disables descendant matching. isPending is currently always false.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Use useNavigation for page request state. Do not rely on isPending to show a loader or action indicator in the current implementation.
